multi_entity_note: Three parties (Prime Energy, Guaranty Bank, Prime Offshore) plus a separate Credit Agreement.

contract.document_name.rationale: OCR-garbled title 'Completion and Liquidity Maintenance Agreement' appears as heading and in the preamble; 'Agreement'/'Credit Agreement' are a defined term and another agreement.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: Preamble says made and entered into effective as of June 29, 2006; other dates belong to the Credit Agreements.

contract.effective_date.rationale: Agreement is 'entered into effective as of June 29, 2006'; c1 is the Credit Agreement's date.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: Agreement remains in force until Project Completion; no expiration date stated.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Governed by laws of the State of Texas; the second 'Texas' is the court venue.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No renewal or non-renewal notice provision.
